F.data_reference: definitional; Faraday constant, SN_simple's rounding of the CODATA 2018 exact value 96485.33212 C/mol

R.data_reference: definitional; gas constant, SN_simple's rounding of the CODATA 2018 exact value 8.314462618 J/(mol K)

T.data_reference: davis2021transcriptomic; Methods (Ch. 2): "All recordings were performed at room temperature" (value not stated; 22 degC assumed); p. 215: neurons died above 30 degC

B_Ca_init.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'user_defined'); at equilibrium with Cai_init the free buffer would be B_tot Kd/(Kd + Cai) = 7.990 mM (Kd = 80 uM)

B_Ca_total.data_reference: matveev2002new; Table 1 ("actual" set): total of the FIXED (immobile) buffer 8 mM (= value). Matveev's mobile buffer is 0.56 mM (Kd 4 uM); here the 8 mM is used for the model's buffer

Ca_ER_init.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; initial ER Ca (relaxes to its steady state); resting ER-lumen Ca measured 60-270 uM in rat sensory neurons (solovyova2002ca), 0.6 mM kept on review

Cai_init.data_reference: wanaverbecq2003plasma; resting [Ca2+]i 102 +- 4 nM (n = 83) in cultured rat superior cervical ganglion neurons (indo-1), Results, first section; 1e-4 mM = value. (Replaces the CA reference hagiwara1981calcium, which could not be opened)

Cao.data_reference: tao2011model; Supporting Material (Document S1) parameter list: [Ca2+]o = 2 mM (listed for the SA-node cell; no separate neuron value). khaliq2003contribution also uses 2 mM

D_Ca.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value (CA token 'identified_by_hand'); sub-membrane to bulk exchange coefficient (exchange time Vol c_SL/D_Ca = 6.7 us)

D_Ca_ER.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value (CA token 'need_to_change_for_volume'); lumped pre-ER-to-ER exchange coefficient

H_SERCA.data_reference: shannon2004mathematical; Table 11, SR Ca pump Hill coefficient H = 1.787 (= value)

K_mf.data_reference: shannon2004mathematical; Table 11, SR Ca pump Kmf = 0.246 uM; modified here to 0.1 uM (was 0.246e-3 mM)

K_mr.data_reference: shannon2004mathematical; Table 11, SR Ca pump Kmr = 1.7 mM; modified here to 0.5 mM (was 1.7)

Vol.data_reference: bennett1998sympathetic; p. 434: rat vas deferens sympathetic varicosities ~1.1 um long x 0.5 um wide (EM; Cottee et al. 1996), i.e. ~0.14-0.22 um^3. **Kept on review 2026-10-05 at the owner's 1 um^3 (~5-7x the source; used when unconnected, the varicosity membrane supplies Vol)**

c_ER.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'user_defined'); ER volume fraction. Li & Rinzel / De Young & Keizer c1 = 0.185 is the ER/cytosol volume ratio, a different quantity and value

c_ER_pre.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'user_defined'); pre-ER volume fraction

k_A_ER.data_reference: definitional; ER area shape factor A_ER = k_A_ER (V_ER/k_V_ER)^(2/3), V_ER = c_ER Vol; a sphere (pi)

k_V_ER.data_reference: definitional; ER volume shape factor of a sphere, pi/6

k_A_ER_pre.data_reference: definitional; pre-ER area shape factor A_ER_pre = k_A_ER_pre (V_ER_pre/k_V_ER_pre)^(2/3), V_ER_pre = c_ER_pre Vol; a sphere (pi)

k_V_ER_pre.data_reference: definitional; pre-ER volume shape factor of a sphere, pi/6

c_SL.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's sub-membrane volume fraction (CA token 'user_defined_TO_BE_FOUND'); kept for the varicosity on review 2026-10-05 (the soma uses a Khaliq 0.1 um shell instead)

rho_SERCA.data_reference: definitional; chosen so that k_SERCA = A rho r_SERCA / N_A reproduces the previous k_SERCA = 1.5e-19 mol_per_s (to_be_identified) with A = 0.6476 um^2 (the varicosity pre-ER membrane area) and r_SERCA = 20 per_s; a density for calibration through r_SERCA

r_SERCA.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; maximal Ca transport per SERCA pump, ~10-20 Ca/s at room temperature (Lytton et al. 1992, value not verified from the paper); 20 Ca/s assumed

k_bind_Ca.data_reference: matveev2002new; Table 1: buffer on-rate 0.5 /uM/ms (= 0.5e6 /mM/s, "actual" fixed buffer) and 0.1 /uM/ms in the "quoted" set (Tang et al. 2000); 0.1e6 /mM/s = the quoted value, paired here with the actual-set off-rate (was 0.5e6)

k_bind_Ca_ER.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'user_defined')

rho_leak_Ca.data_reference: definitional; chosen so that k_leak_Ca = A rho k_leak_Ca_single (1e-18 m3/um3) reproduces the previous k_leak_Ca = 2e-20 m3_per_s (user_defined) with A = 0.6476 um^2 (the varicosity pre-ER membrane area) and k_leak_Ca_single = 0.01 um3_per_s; a density for calibration through k_leak_Ca_single

k_leak_Ca_single.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; per-protein Ca leak coefficient (flux per concentration difference) of an ER leak pathway; 0.01 um^3/s assumed

k_unbind_Ca.data_reference: matveev2002new; Table 1 ("actual" set): fixed-buffer off-rate 8 /ms = 8e3 /s (= value; Kd 16 uM with kon 0.5 /uM/ms; with the kon 0.1 used here Kd = 80 uM)

k_unbind_Ca_ER.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; matveev2002new fixed-buffer off-rate 8e3 /s reused for the pre-ER buffer; no source for an ER-adjacent buffer

j_Ca_in.data_reference: definitional; 0 when nothing is connected to this sum: no Ca influx from unconnected channels

j_ER_release.data_reference: definitional; 0 when nothing is connected to this sum: no ER Ca release without a connected release channel
